title: The Night of the Exorcism comes to Switch Oct. 30th, 2026
excerpt: Seems like a smart night to release it
content:
Seems like a smart night to release it

Ratalaika Games is bringing The Night of the Exorcism to the Switch on Oct. 30th, 2026 and you can check out a trailer above.

Summoned to the remote village of Southshire-Upon-Yail, you must diagnose the afflictions of a young woman that suffers a mysterious illness.

Each decision you make will unveil a piece of the mystery and bring you closer to discovering the truth behind her ailments, and whatever harms her.

The devils inside Isabella will not be removed easily. Navigate the seven creatures that hold her life in her hands, and find a way to expel them one by one – or succumb to their temptations.

The secrets of Hell can be discovered, at a cost, and only through information can your exorcism succeed. But can you trick the demons into exposing their cores, or will you leave yourself open to them?
